name: kaiku
title: Kaiku
description: Control Kaiku recordings and search, read and ask about your calls.
author: gabry-ts

commands.name: start-recording
commands.title: Start Recording
commands.subtitle: Kaiku
commands.description: Start recording a call, with an optional title.

commands.name: toggle-pause
commands.title: Pause or Resume Recording
commands.subtitle: Kaiku
commands.description: Pause the current recording, or resume it if it is paused.

commands.name: add-bookmark
commands.title: Add Bookmark
commands.subtitle: Kaiku
commands.description: Add a bookmark at the current moment of the recording.

commands.name: toggle-mute
commands.title: Mute or Unmute Microphones
commands.subtitle: Kaiku
commands.description: Mute every microphone on the Mac, or unmute them.

commands.name: search-calls
commands.title: Search Calls
commands.subtitle: Kaiku
commands.description: Search your recorded calls and their transcripts.

commands.name: ask-calls
commands.title: Ask Calls
commands.subtitle: Kaiku
commands.description: Ask a question about your calls in the Kaiku chat.
